expected_verdict_reason: The captured FIG-LX1 runs stock EMUI on Android 9, user build with release-keys, and reports none of the three A/B markers, so the absence rule reads it as single, as LineageOS lists it (recovery partition, no is_ab_device). The model is listed upstream. The bootloader reports locked, and LineageOS states that no official unlock method is available, so the recipe carries unlock_route withdrawn_by_maker: cannot-verify, not 'unlock first'.

bootloader_state.source_evidence: LineageOS figo: an official method of unlocking the bootloader is not available; the phone reports its state in ro.boot.flash.locked (the captured FIG-LX1 reports 1, locked)
